title: SelectboxColumn in data editor not working when fragment with run_every is active
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [x] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [x] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

When a data editor with a selectbox column is used in conjunction with a fragment with active run_every (not inside the fragment), the options further down in the select box cannot be selected. While scrolling, the scroll position automatically jumps to the top with every fragment rerun, making options further down unreachable.

### Reproducible Code Example

```Python
import string
import pandas as pd
import streamlit as st

st.session_state.counter = 0
st.title("Minimal Working Example")


[USER].fragment(run_every=0.5)
def fragment():
    st.session_state.counter += 1
    st.write(f"Counter: {st.session_state.counter}")


if st.toggle("Run Fragment", value=True):
    fragment()

data = pd.DataFrame({'column_1': ['b']})
st.data_editor(
    data,
    hide_index=True,
    column_config={
        'column_1': st.column_config.SelectboxColumn("Select", options=list(string.ascii_lowercase))
    }
)
```

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Double click on the cell containing *b* in *column_1*
2. Try to scroll down in the opened select window
3. Notice that the scroll position resets every 0.5 seconds (each fragment rerun)
4. Disable the toggle *Run Fragment*
5. Open the selection window once more and notice that scrolling works

### Expected Behavior

The scroll position remains at the current position unless I scroll further up or down.

### Current Behavior

The scroll position automatically scrolls back to the top with every fragment run.

### Is this a regression?

- [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.47.0
- Python version: 3.13.4
- Operating System: MacOS Sequoia 15.5
- Browser: Safari, Firefox, Chrome


### Additional Information

_No response_
